description: Bring your Qminder queue management into ChatGPT. Check scheduled appointments, see which customers are waiting, and call the next person in line—all by asking naturally. You can also view all your locations at a glance, and monitor iPad and TV status. A simple way to stay on top of customer flow without leaving the conversation.
